title: Nasty Juice Green Ape 50/50 10ml E-Liquid
description: Green Ape e-liquid from Nasty Juice is bursting with succulent, juicy green apple and a cool, uplifting layer of fresh garden Mint. Sweet and mild with just the right amount of sour tang, this e-liquid is unfailingly delicious from the first vape to the last. This e-liquid from Nasty Juice offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing immaculate flavour and rich, satisfying clouds. This e-liquid is versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits .
